name: Enchanted Wilds
notes: Set-level parameters as of 18.1. Nothing here is 'verified' yet: odds and pool sizes come from a third-party site and must be checked against the in-game tooltip before they count as verified.

shop_odds.note: Percent per cost tier 1..5 by player level. Check against the in-game shop odds tooltip.

champions_per_cost.note: Should be cross-checked against the champion list once it is added.

shop_slots.source: long-standing TFT shop size; not checked for Set 18
shop_slots.note: Champion slots in a shop without a Wisp. See shop_rules.wisp_slot.

reroll_cost.source: long-standing TFT value; not checked for Set 18

xp_purchase.source: long-standing TFT value; not checked for Set 18

passive_xp_per_round.source: to be read from the in-game tooltip or patch notes

xp_to_next_level.source: to be read from the in-game XP bar for each level

max_level.source: shop_odds lists levels up to 11, but the normal cap without augments is not confirmed

base_income.source: per-round base gold by stage; to be read in-game

interest_per_10_gold.source: long-standing TFT value; not checked for Set 18

interest_cap.source: long-standing TFT value; not checked for Set 18

streak_gold.source: bonus gold by win/loss streak length; to be read in-game

pvp_win_gold.source: gold for winning a player combat; to be read in-game

wisp_slot.source: Riot patch 18.1 notes ('Wisps appear in every other shop') https://teamfighttactics.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/game-updates/teamfight-tactics-patch-18-1 ; rightmost slot: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/TFT:Enchanted_Wilds
wisp_slot.note: Whether the Wisp replaces one of the 5 champion slots is not confirmed. Off by default; run as a scenario variant.

inferno_upgrade.source: Inferno trait: shop slots roll one cost tier higher (esports.gg Set 18 overview); exact rule unknown

riftbeast_shop.source: Riftbeast (5): next shop overrun with Riftbeasts every few combats (esports.gg Set 18 overview); exact rule unknown

bad_luck_protection.source: parameter block seen in Set 11 game files (ACIK_KAYNAK_INCELEME.md 2.5); Set 18 status unknown
